recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-23077. Treat FHIR-54057 as separate future R6 cleanup/deprecation work if it reaches the Applied/Published scope.
issue_request: FHIR-23077 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking CapabilityStatement to expose a per-resource conditionalPatch flag because HTTP conditional PATCH is only a SHOULD when PATCH and conditional update are supported and clients need an explicit discovery point.
initial_application: Git commit 2c5ab97acd02c2ef8485612d3193b54102bc6a4a, dated 2022-08-25 and titled 'FHIR-23077 CapabilityStatement should include conditionalPatch flag', added CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.conditionalPatch to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml and updated the example/supporting files. Current source still contains the element and example usage.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the conformance work group. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-11-04 corroborate the Persuasive 7-0-0 disposition. FHIR-54057 is a later R6 Resolved - change required proposal to deprecate conditional* CapabilityStatement elements in favor of interaction codes, but it is not Applied/Published and does not reverse the seed for this run. Corrected Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml already defines CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.conditionalPatch as a 0..1 boolean with the requested definition, and source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement-example.xml includes conditionalPatch with the neighboring conditional capability flags.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 proposal to deprecate conditional* CapabilityStatement elements; relevant background, but out of the default Applied/Published source-edit scope and not a reason to change FHIR-23077 here.
